overview: The Medford Comprehensive High School Building Committee met to approve a series of space efficiency reductions across academic, vocational, and special education departments to lower project costs. The committee also debated and voted on the scope of the high school's pool project.

items.title: Meeting Minutes
items.summary: Approved the meeting minutes from September 10, 2026, as amended to clarify the projected number of district MEEP classrooms.

items.title: Core Academic Space Efficiencies
items.summary: Approved reducing general classroom sizes from 950 to 900 square feet to align Medford with peer communities and reduce project costs.

items.title: Medford Academy Space Efficiencies
items.summary: Approved space reductions for Medford Academy, including reducing its two classrooms from 950 to 900 square feet.

items.title: Special Education Space Efficiencies
items.summary: Approved space efficiencies for special education areas, matching general classroom reductions and eliminating two therapeutic learning program office spaces.

items.title: Chapter 74 CTE Space Efficiencies
items.summary: Approved space efficiency adjustments for several vocational program areas, including Graphic Design, Health Assisting, and Carpentry.

items.title: Non-Chapter 74 Lab Spaces
items.summary: Approved the proposed space configurations for non-vocational lab spaces, which resulted in no net change to project square footage.

items.title: Media Center Space Allocation
items.summary: Approved the proposed space allocations for the media center, keeping the design within MSBA guidelines.

items.title: Pool Project Scope and Learn-to-Swim Basin
items.summary: Voted to eliminate a proposed $7.6 million learn-to-swim basin addition from the project scope to control taxpayer costs and avoid site constriction.
